meaning.zh: 當前文已清楚說明某個想法時，so 可以代替肯定子句或意思，not 可以代替否定子句或意思。

rules.zh: 本課的 so 和 not 代替完整子句或想法，而不是普通名詞。
rules.en: So and not replace a whole clause or idea in this lesson; they cannot replace an ordinary object such as a book, bag or ticket.
examples: Will Anna attend the meeting? I think so.

rules.zh: 前文意思必須清楚，讓讀者或聽者知道 so 或 not 所指的是哪個完整意思。
rules.en: The earlier idea must be clear so that the reader or listener can identify exactly what so or not replaces.
examples: Will the shop open tomorrow? I think so.

rules.zh: not 不能直接跟隨所有動詞。I hope not、I suppose not 和 I am afraid not 很自然；一般應說 I do not believe so 或 I do not imagine so。
rules.en: Not cannot follow every verb directly. I hope not, I suppose not and I am afraid not are natural, whereas ordinary English normally uses I do not believe so or I do not imagine so.

rules.zh: 一般不使用 know so；應說 I know that it is true、I know it 或 I know this。
rules.en: Do not normally use know so. Say I know that it is true, I know it or I know this instead.
examples: I know that it is true.

rules.zh: 普通否定意見通常保留 think so，說 I do not think so；I think not 雖可見於正式或強調語境，但不是本課主要形式。
rules.en: Keep think so after the negative auxiliary in ordinary English: I do not think so is the main pattern. I think not is possible but sounds more formal or emphatic.

rules.zh: 不要把本課代替子句的 so 與 so tired、so that、So do I、表示結果的 so 或 do so 混淆。
rules.en: Do not confuse substitution so with degree so, purpose so that, agreement So do I, result so or the pro-form do so. Only so replacing an earlier clause or idea is the target.

rules.zh: 不要把代替否定子句的 not 與普通否定混淆；在 I am afraid not 中，not 代替完整否定意思。
rules.en: Do not confuse substitution not with ordinary negation. In I am afraid not, not replaces the complete negative idea rather than simply modifying one following word.
examples: Is the door open? I am afraid not.

benefits.zh: 只用一個簡短字代替完整重複意思，能避免不必要的重複。
benefits.en: It prevents unnecessary repetition by replacing a complete repeated clause with one short word.

benefits.zh: I think so、I hope not 和 I am afraid so 等常用框架令短答更流利自然。
benefits.en: It makes short answers sound fluent through common ready-made responses such as I think so, I hope not and I am afraid so.

benefits.zh: so 或 not 前的 think、hope、suppose、be afraid 或 certainly 等詞能顯示意見、希望、疑問、壞消息或確定判斷。
benefits.en: It helps show the speaker’s attitude, including opinion, hope, doubt, unwelcome news or a confident judgement.

benefits.zh: If so 和 If not 能清楚連接兩種條件及相應做法，而不必重複完整條件。
benefits.en: It connects conditions clearly: if so and if not introduce different instructions without repeating the complete condition.

benefits.zh: 目標詞可出現在短答、句首條件、較長句子中間、問句或報述動詞後，增加句式變化。
benefits.en: It gives more varied sentence structures because the substitute may appear in a response, a condition, a longer sentence, a question or after a reporting verb.

benefits.zh: or so + 報述動詞能審慎轉述別人的聲稱，而不必完全確認其真確性。
benefits.en: Or so + reporting verb helps report another person’s claim carefully without fully confirming that it is true.
